ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Minimoa uses the camera for your profile photo, your habit proofs and photo challenges. Your profile photo is checked automatically by our AI provider before it is shown. A habit proof is only sent to it if you have agreed; no human looks at it. Proofs and challenge photos are deleted within 24 hours, except the ones you keep.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Minimoa uses your location, only while the app is open, to introduce you to compatible people near you and to confirm your outings. Your exact location is never saved: only a point rounded to about 300 m. Without it, you can choose your city by hand.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Minimoa saves to your photos only the image you choose to save.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Minimoa opens your photo library only for the profile photo you choose. It is checked automatically by our AI provider before it is shown.
